lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: charan sev sa(n)t saadh ke sagal manorath poore ||3||
lines.translation: Serving at the Feet of the Holy Saints, all desires are fulfilled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat ek varatadaa jal thal maheeal poore ||4||
lines.translation: In each and every heart, the One Lord is pervading. He is totally permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: paap binaasan seviaa pavitr sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||5||
lines.translation: I serve the Destroyer of sin, and I am sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਛਡਾਈ ਖਸਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਠਰੂਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sabh chhadaaee khasam aap har jap bhaee tharoore ||6||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master Himself has saved me completely; I am comforted by meditating on the Lord. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: karatai keeaa tapaavaso dusat mue hoi moore ||7||
lines.translation: The Creator has passed judgement, and the evil-doers have been silenced and killed. ||7||

lines.transliteration: naanak rataa sach naai har vekhai sadaa hajoore ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||
lines.translation: Nanak is attuned to the True Name; he beholds the Presence of the Ever-present Lord. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਂਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: baarah maahaa maa(n)jh mahalaa 5 ghar 4 ||
lines.translation: Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਵੀਛੁੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirat karam ke veechhuRe kar kirapaa melahu raam ||
lines.translation: By the actions we have committed, we are separated from You. Please show Your Mercy, and unite us with Yourself, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਥਕਿ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaar ku(n)t dah dis bhrame thak aae prabh kee saam ||
lines.translation: We have grown weary of wandering to the four corners of the earth and in the ten directions. We have come to Your Sanctuary, God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੇਨੁ ਦੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhen dudhai te baaharee kitai na aavai kaam ||
lines.translation: Without milk, a cow serves no purpose.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਖ ਕੁਮਲਾਵਤੀ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal bin saakh kumalaavatee upajahi naahee daam ||
lines.translation: Without water, the crop withers, and it will not bring a good price.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹ ਨ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਾਜਨੈ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naah na mileeai saajanai kat paaeeai bisaraam ||
lines.translation: If we do not meet the Lord, our Friend, how can we find our place of rest?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ਭਠਿ ਨਗਰ ਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ghar har ka(n)t na pragataee bhath nagar se graam ||
lines.translation: Those homes, those hearts, in which the Husband Lord is not manifest-those towns and villages are like burning furnaces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਸਣੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: srab seegaar ta(n)bol ras san dehee sabh khaam ||
lines.translation: All decorations, the chewing of betel to sweeten the breath, and the body itself, are all useless and vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਮੀਤ ਸਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh suaamee ka(n)t vihooneeaa meet sajan sabh jaam ||
lines.translation: Without God, our Husband, our Lord and Master, all friends and companions are like the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa kar kirapaa deejai naam ||
lines.translation: This is Nanak's prayer: "Please show Your Mercy, and bestow Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har melahu suaamee sa(n)g prabh jis kaa nihachal dhaam ||1||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with Yourself, O God, in the Eternal Mansion of Your Presence". ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chet govi(n)d araadheeai hovai ana(n)d ghanaa ||
lines.translation: In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep and profound joy arises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil paaeeai rasanaa naam bhanaa ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints, the Lord is found, as we chant His Name with our tongues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਗਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin paaiaa prabh aapanaa aae tisahi ganaa ||
lines.translation: Those who have found God-blessed is their coming into this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik khin tis bin jeevanaa birathaa janam janaa ||
lines.translation: Those who live without Him, for even an instant-their lives are rendered useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਰਵਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa raviaa vich vanaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is totally pervading the water, the land, and all space. He is contained in the forests as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਤੜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh chit na aavaee kitaRaa dukh ganaa ||
lines.translation: Those who do not remember God-how much pain must they suffer!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee raaviaa so prabhoo ti(n)naa bhaag manaa ||
lines.translation: Those who dwell upon their God have great good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੰਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har darasan ka(n)u man lochadaa naanak piaas manaa ||
lines.translation: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. O Nanak, my mind is so thirsty!

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chet milaae so prabhoo tis kai paai lagaa ||2||
lines.translation: I touch the feet of one who unites me with God in the month of Chayt. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੈਸਾਖਿ ਧੀਰਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਵਾਢੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaisaakh dheeran kiu vaadheeaa jinaa prem bichhohu ||
lines.translation: In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har saajan purakh visaar kai lagee maaiaa dhohu ||
lines.translation: She has forgotten the Lord, her Life-companion, her Master; she has become attached to Maya, the deceitful one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਓਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: putr kalatr na sa(n)g dhanaa har avinaasee ohu ||
lines.translation: Neither son, nor spouse, nor wealth shall go along with you-only the Eternal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਲਚਿ ਪਲਚਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੁਈ ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: palach palach sagalee muee jhoothai dha(n)dhai mohu ||
lines.translation: Entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations, the whole world is perishing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਲਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas har ke naam bin agai laeeahi khohi ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, they lose their lives in the hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਯੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: day visaar viguchanaa prabh bin avar na koi ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Merciful Lord, they are ruined. Without God, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: preetam charanee jo lage tin kee niramal soi ||
lines.translation: Pure is the reputation of those who are attached to the Feet of the Beloved Lord.
